title: Zacks: Analysts Expect Apple (AAPL) Will Announce Quarterly Sales of $52.40 Billion
text:
Wall Street analysts expect Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report $52.40 billion in sales for the current quarter, reports. Seven analysts have made estimates for Apple’s earnings, with the lowest sales estimate coming in at $51.74 billion and the highest estimate coming in at $52.80 billion. Apple posted sales of $45.41 billion in the same quarter last year, which would indicate a positive year-over-year growth rate of 15.4%. The company is scheduled to announce its next quarterly earnings report on Tuesday, August 7th.
According to Zacks, analysts expect that Apple will report full-year sales of $260.21 billion for the current year, with estimates ranging from $258.63 billion to $262.14 billion. For the next financial year, analysts anticipate that the company will post sales of $268.51 billion per share, with estimates ranging from $255.33 billion to $280.76 billion. ’s sales calculations are an average based on a survey of sell-side research firms that cover Apple. Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its earnings results on Tuesday, May 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.73 quarter, topping analysts’ consensus estimates of $2.69 by $0.04. Apple had a net margin of 21.55% and a return on equity of 39.97%. The firm had revenue of $61.14 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $60.94 billion. During the same period in the previous year, the firm posted $2.10 EPS. The business’s quarterly revenue was up 15.6% on a year-over-year basis. A number of equities analysts recently commented on AAPL shares. Atlantic Securities reaffirmed a “neutral” rating and set a $185.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research note on Wednesday. DZ Bank reaffirmed a “buy” rating on shares of Apple in a research note on Thursday. Citigroup reaffirmed a “focus list” rating and set a $142.20 price target (up from $100.00) on shares of Apple in a research note on Wednesday. raised shares of Apple from a “sell” rating to a “hold” rating in a research note on Thursday. Finally, Barclays lifted their price target on shares of Apple from $157.00 to $161.00 and gave the stock a “neutral” rating in a research note on Wednesday. One analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have issued a hold rating, thirty-three have issued a buy rating and two have issued a strong buy rating to the company. The company currently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and an average target price of $204.00.

Following the sale, the insider now directly owns 64,475 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $11,261,203.50. Insiders have sold a total of 125,988 shares of company stock worth $21,336,201 in the last 90 days. 0.08% of the stock is currently owned by company insiders.

Jarislowsky Fraser Ltd now owns 22,515 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $3,470,000 after acquiring an additional 4,118 shares during the last quarter. Shelton Capital Management boosted its holdings in Apple by 2.3% during the third quarter. Finally, Hikari Power Ltd purchased a new stake in Apple during the third quarter worth $208,000. 61.18% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors and hedge funds.
Apple stock opened at $183.83 on Friday. Apple has a twelve month low of $142.20 and a twelve month high of $184.20. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.80, a quick ratio of 1.20 and a current ratio of 1.46. The stock has a market capitalization of $895,918.56, a PE ratio of 19.96, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.35 and a beta of 1.26.
Apple declared that its Board of Directors has initiated a share buyback plan on Tuesday, May 1st that authorizes the company to buyback $100.00 billion in outstanding shares. This buyback authorization authorizes the iPhone maker to buy up to 11.9% of its stock through open market purchases. Stock buyback plans are generally a sign that the company’s management believes its stock is undervalued.
The business also recently declared a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Thursday, May 17th. Shareholders of record on Monday, May 14th will be paid a dividend of $0.73 per share. This is a positive change from Apple’s previous quarterly dividend of $0.63. The ex-dividend date of this dividend is Friday, May 11th. This represents a $2.92 dividend on an annualized basis and a yield of 1.59%. Apple’s dividend payout ratio is presently 27.36%.
Apple Company Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
